panels.title: The expert
panels.story: Iven steps toward the handwheel with an easy raised-brow smile. Mara waits beside him. The calm creature faces the closed gate from upstream.
panels.shot: Wide eye-level establishment, full bodies and all four creature tentacles visible.
required_visible: Both adults, complete feet on dry ledge
One waiting pony-scale creature with four broad tentacles
Closed gate seated at waterline inside one broad arch
Handwheel with one intact short wooden grip at3 o’clock
panels.action: Iven takes one small step toward wheel; right hand remains empty and open. Mara looks from him to the creature.
panels.expression: Iven friendly confidence; Mara patient mild doubt; creature calm.
panels.continuity: No broken wood. Equal calm water level on both sides. Nothing already passes beneath the gate.

panels.title: A little force
panels.story: Iven braces the iron rim with his left hand and pulls the wooden grip with his right. His confident smile tightens; the gate does not move.
panels.shot: Medium three-quarter south-side view, Iven from upper thighs through face plus entire wheel.
required_visible: Iven anatomical LEFT hand visibly bracing iron rim at10 o’clock
Iven anatomical RIGHT hand wrapped around intact wooden grip at3 o’clock
Single continuous wooden grip from rim to right fist
Iven face, shoulder origins and wheel mounting
panels.action: Left shoulder/arm leads to iron rim; right shoulder/arm leads to wooden grip. The grip is pulled outward toward the south camera, not turned yet.
panels.expression: Iven strained smile, pursed concentration; a sliver of Mara may watch from frame left.
panels.continuity: Gate fully closed, wheel orientation unchanged. No separate wooden fragment or pre-existing crack gap.

panels.title: The snap
panels.story: The wooden grip breaks. Iven’s left hand stays on the iron rim while his right hand recoils with the detached long piece. His eyes widen. A short wooden stub remains fixed to the same rim point.
panels.shot: Tight three-quarter detail of both hands, rim, clear break gap and Iven’s startled eyes/upper face.
required_visible: Exactly two wooden pieces:0.05m mounted stub and0.13m detached remnant
Visible air gap between matching jagged ends, not a merely drawn seam
Left fingers still around iron rim at10 o’clock
Right fist and detached remnant visibly separate from wheel
Traceable sleeve origins and startled Iven eyes
panels.action: The right fist recoils southward and slightly upward. Stub stays at3 o’clock. Show one clean snapped joint; no spray of loose splinters that could be mistaken for extra fragments.
panels.expression: Iven startled embarrassment; his boast visibly collapses.
panels.continuity: Gate remains closed; wheel has not rotated. Remnant stays in anatomical right hand thereafter.

panels.title: Use the rim
panels.story: Iven has stepped aside with the broken grip. Mara plants a wide stance and turns the iron rim with both hands. The gate begins to rise; the creature still waits upstream.
panels.shot: Low-to-eye-level full-body action view of Mara, both planted sandals, wheel and lifting gate in one frame.
required_visible: Mara’s complete powerful plus-size body, grounded wide stance and both sandals
Both palms/fingers touching opposite iron rim positions, not wooden stub
Wheel has turned45° clockwise viewed from south; stub at4:30
Gate bottom visibly lifted0.75m from waterline
Iven clear at frame left with right-hand wooden remnant
Creature still upstream, not beneath half-open gate
panels.action: Mara leans through a clear hip-and-shoulder twist, turning clockwise. Her left hand is near9 o’clock and right near2 o’clock at this depicted instant; neither hand uses the wooden stub.
panels.expression: Mara focused, matter-of-fact effort; Iven sheepish, watching.
panels.continuity: Mid-action state only: total quarter-turn is not complete. No extra lever or new gate. Water level unchanged; only a few small ripples.

panels.title: A clear passage
panels.story: The gate is fully raised. The creature has passed downstream. Mara has walked around the south pier and rests one open palm gently on its near shell edge as it glides by. Iven still holds the remnant.
panels.shot: Wide south-side view, same travel direction asP01, all of creature and clear opening visible.
required_visible: Gate fully raised with1.5m clear opening and visible water beneath
Wheel at90° clockwise; fixed short stub now at6 o’clock
All four broad creature tentacles completely downstream of gate
Mara’s feet on ledge, open anatomical LEFT palm gently touching near shell edge
Iven and his right-hand remnant still present at frame left
panels.action: Creature travels left-to-right; Mara touches shell at[1.65,.55,.92] without pulling it or standing in water. Its nearest tentacle remains in canal. Passage follows the wheel action.
panels.expression: Mara soft satisfied smile; creature calm and receptive; Iven subdued.
panels.continuity: Opening remains raised. Creature is the same size/design and has not duplicated. No new wound, wet-clothing gag, loose wood or extra prop.

panels.title: Credit where due
panels.story: Iven joins Mara downstream and displays the broken grip in his right hand with a small defensive smile. Mara answers with one raised brow. The gate remains raised behind them; the creature continues rightward.
panels.shot: Medium two-shot, faces and right-hand remnant prominent; open gate readable in the quiet gap behind the adults.
required_visible: Iven’s refined adult face and Mara’s broad adult face, different readable expressions
Same0.13m detached wooden remnant displayed in Iven anatomical RIGHT hand
Open gate remains visible behind the adults; no reclosed barrier
Mara stands relaxed with empty hands; creature may be partly visible exiting frame right
panels.action: Iven raises the remnant only to chest height; left hand empty. Mara turns her head toward him without taking the wood.
panels.expression: Iven sheepish self-justification; Mara deadpan raised brow, slight amused mouth.
panels.continuity: No repaired crank, replacement wheel, identity/costume change or owner-favorite implication.
